findings.title: test_create_ticket_null_priority fails after priority field change
findings.description: The test asserts priority is null but the changed code now accepts an integer value. The assertion fails with AssertionError: assert 1 == None.
findings.recommendation: Update the test to assert the new expected value, or revert the change in service.py if null was intentional.

findings.title: No test asserts behaviour when priority is supplied as null
findings.description: The diff introduces a priority field. No test sends priority=null explicitly and asserts it is accepted and echoed back.
findings.recommendation: Add test_create_ticket_null_priority: POST /tickets with {"title": "T", "priority": null}, assert 201 and body["priority"] is None.

limitations: All existing tests passed, but passing tests do not prove that changed behaviours are asserted. See behaviour-map.md for gaps.
